Hi Alex — thanks for the note and the authorization PDF. A few items to keep the workflow moving: 

1) For any bank/account changes we require a completed vendor change form, a copy of the voided check (or bank letter on bank letterhead), and an updated W-9 (for tax).
2) Please confirm the exact vendor portal ID (if different from the one in HubSpot) and whether the remit address should replace the current remit or be added as an alternate.
3) Our AP change window is 3–5 business days after we receive the above docs and verification. We’ll schedule an ACH test payment as a final verification step.

I’ve looped in Marissa from Accounts Payable to prep the change on her end — Marissa, can you confirm the required internal approvals and whether we need Legal to touch the change?

Thanks,
